question.problem:
Find the general formula for the $n$th term of the arithmetic sequence that begins with 

$$
2,\,11,\,20,\,…
$$
question.worked_solution:
The formula for the $n$th term of an arithmetic sequence (in function notation) is

$$
f(n)=f(1)+(n-1)d.
$$

From the first few terms

$$
2,\,11,\,20,\,…,
$$

we see that the first term is $f(1)=2$ and the common difference is 

$$
d=11-2=9.
$$

So, we substitute into the formula and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(n) & =f(1)+(n-1)d \\  & =2+(n-1)(9) \\  & =2+9n-9 \\  & =9n-7\end{aligned}
$$

        

Therefore, the formula for the $n$th term is $f(n)=9n-7.$
